towns.name: Plateau Village
towns.summary: Plateau Village (44.5N 43.1W, north-western Osteth, Aluvian realm) is a remote settlement on top of a large z 240 plateau: the spice merchant and the planar mage who opens the way to Frore are its draws, and the Town Network, the Oriel Residential Halls and twenty-odd housing-settlement portals make it a hub. The village (LB 0x49B6) is a cluster of seven two- and three-storey Aluvian timber-and-brick houses (roofs to z 252.5) around the Town Network portal and the Nullified Statue of a Skeleton on a column plinth, with candelabras at the doors and the Life Stone on the southern rim; a 65 m escarpment drops north into an east-west ravine (floor z 150-175). Across the ravine, on a promontory with a 150 m drop to the west, lies the Plateau Wedding site: two orange-leaved lantern trees hung with 15 brass lanterns each, an aisle of benches lined by ten blue-flame torches, an altar with standing flame lanterns and flowers, and twin 15.5 m stone pillars crowned with green and blue glows.
